metadata.question: Were active fire counts in Punjab and Haryana during November 2024 lower than during November 2022, as observed with the VIIRS sensor?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use the VIIRS Active Fire product: NASA/VIIRS/VNP14A1. It is an 8-day composite but contains daily information in the band "FireMask". Filter for Punjab and Haryana, two spatial polygons, and the two Novembers. 2. Masking: We don't mask clouds, but we do need to consider valid active-fire pixels. We'll count pixels whose FireMask equals 7-9 (low-high confidence active fire). 3. Logic: Compute total fire-pixel counts for each region and year. Quantify valid pixels; if 0 remain after filtering, output C2. If any collection is empty (size() == 0), output C1. If calculation returns None/NaN, output C3. Otherwise decide A (2024 < 2022) or B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Regions and time punjab = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[73.9,30.2],[75.9,30.2],[75.9,32.1],[73.9,32.1],[73.9,30.2]] ]) haryana = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[75.2,27.8],[77.2,27.8],[77.2,30.7],[75.2,30.7],[75.2,27.8]] ]) roi = punjab.union(haryana) def get_fire_count(year): col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/VIIRS/VNP14A1') .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(11, 11, 'month')) .filterBounds(roi)) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None fire = col.map(lambda img: img.select('FireMask').gte(7).And(img.select('FireMask').lte(9))) total = fire.sum().rename('fire') cnt = total.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=roi, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('fire').getInfo() return cnt # 2. Retrieve counts n22 = get_fire_count(2022) n24 = get_fire_count(2024) print(f"Nov 2022 fire pixels: {n22}") print(f"Nov 2024 fire pixels: {n24}") # 3. Decision logic if n22 is None or n24 is None: print("C1") elif n22 < 0 or n24 < 0 or n22 != n22 or n24 != n24: print("C3") elif n24 < n22: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Regions and time
punjab = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[73.9,30.2],[75.9,30.2],[75.9,32.1],[73.9,32.1],[73.9,30.2]]
])
haryana = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[75.2,27.8],[77.2,27.8],[77.2,30.7],[75.2,30.7],[75.2,27.8]]
])
roi = punjab.union(haryana)

def get_fire_count(year):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/VIIRS/VNP14A1')
             .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(year, year, 'year'))
             .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(11, 11, 'month'))
             .filterBounds(roi))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None
    fire = col.map(lambda img: img.select('FireMask').gte(7).And(img.select('FireMask').lte(9)))
    total = fire.sum().rename('fire')
    cnt = total.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=roi,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('fire').getInfo()
    return cnt

# 2. Retrieve counts
n22 = get_fire_count(2022)
n24 = get_fire_count(2024)
print(f"Nov 2022 fire pixels: {n22}")
print(f"Nov 2024 fire pixels: {n24}")

# 3. Decision logic
if n22 is None or n24 is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif n22 < 0 or n24 < 0 or n22 != n22 or n24 != n24:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif n24 < n22:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
